user.title: Connect to Immich
user.description: Enter your Immich server URL and API key. The key is stored securely by Home Assistant and never written to the code.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Immich server

abort.already_configured: This Immich server is already configured

data.rebuild_hours: Cache refresh interval in hours (0 = disabled)
data.permanent_persons: Permanent persons (exact names or Immich person IDs, comma separated)
data.min_photos: Minimum photos per guest (below this, their own photos are added and a repair is raised)

picpak.title: PicPak e-ink frames
picpak.description: One frame per bed: frame 1 follows the room's first helper, frame 2 the second. Get the URL to store in each frame with the "PicPak: frame URLs" service.

data.picpak_photos: Photos per frame and per stay
data.picpak_logo: Logo shown when the room is free (path to a PNG)
data.picpak_title: Text logo title, when the logo file is missing
data.picpak_base_url: Local Home Assistant URL as seen by the frames (empty = automatic)

error.room_exists: A room with this name already exists
error.no_helpers: Select at least one input_text helper
error.invalid_base_url: The URL must start with http:// or https://

confirm.title: Link {name} to an Immich person
confirm.description: "{name}" (room: {rooms}) matches nobody in Immich. In Immich, open the person's page and copy its URL (http://…/people/<id>) or just the ID, then paste it here. The link is remembered.

error.invalid_person_id: No valid ID found in this value
error.person_not_found: This ID does not exist in Immich

confirm.title: Link {name} to the right Immich person
confirm.description: "{name}" (room: {rooms}) has only {found} photo(s) in Immich (minimum: {minimum}). All available photos are shown. If this is the wrong person, paste the ID or page URL of the right one; the link is remembered.

error.invalid_person_id: No valid ID found in this value
error.person_not_found: This ID does not exist in Immich

helper_missing.title: Helper not found: {name}
helper_missing.description: The helper "{name}" configured for room {rooms} does not exist, so that room sees no guest. Create it, or fix the room's helpers: Settings → Devices & services → Immich Guest Slideshow → Configure (remove then re-add the room).
